_opportunity_cap_why: 0.0 = LAYER OFF, Cory's ruling 2026-08-17 ('Remove 1'), after draft/audit/opportunity_adjustment_2026-08-16.md graded it for the first time: NEUTRAL on ordering in 17 of 18 cells, WORSE on level in 18 of 18 with every CI clear, and a SHUFFLED control (same magnitudes, randomly reassigned within position) performed identically — so it was carrying scale, not player information. It was also structurally one-sided: composite_z handles WR/TE/RB only, so QB/K/DEF carried exactly 0.0000 while RB/WR/TE reached +0.15, lifting three positions against three others in a VORP that compares across positions. Measured effect of turning it off on the live board: 51 of the top 60 overall ranks move and QB1 goes from rank 16 to 10. CENTRING it instead moved QB1 by ONE, because the distortion is the SPREAD (elite RB/WR/TE pinned at the cap while replacement sits near zero), not the level. HONEST LIMIT: the grade ran on reconstructed baselines that FLATTER the layer, so every positive number was an upper bound; its performance against Sleeper's own preseason baseline is unmeasurable until REC-2 grades it in January 2027. REVERSIBLE: restore 0.15 here, nothing else changes.
_use_measured_ceiling_why: Cory 2026-08-17: 'We absolutely need to change draft board if we aren't considering upside.' He is right and the board could not express upside at all. proj_ceiling was mean + 1.036*proj_sd — and once REC-1 made proj_sd a per-BAND ratio, that is a monotone transform of the mean, IDENTICAL in shape for every player in a cell. Consequences, all three measured: the bench branch (which ranks on ceiling - mean) ranked Jordan Love, Baker Mayfield, Tyler Shough and Sam Darnold as the highest-upside players on the board, because a QB scores 350-400 and his spread is the largest absolute number almost by construction — engine.js's own comment says this 'measures SCALE, NOT UPSIDE' and added a hard cap to paper over it. CEILING_TIEBREAK, which is ON, was a NO-OP: breaking a near-tie by a monotone function of the mean just picks whoever was already ahead. And the composite ceiling weight was measured as collinear with value and zeroed — a true statement about the FORMULA, not a finding about upside. ON turns proj_ceiling into the MEASURED p90 of realized/projected outcomes (projection_error_calibration: 1,304 graded player-seasons, 20 cells). The same bench ranking then reads Gibbs, Bijan, McCaffrey, Jeremiyah Love, CeeDee Lamb. It also moves the board TOWARD anchors and away from deep fliers (band 33+ ceilings fall a median 7.5, bands 1-8 rise 17-30), which is the direction the barbell pass independently supports — that study read this same calibration directly and found anchors out-ceiling swings with zero overlap. This is a correctness fix on measured data, not a strategy bet. Set to false to revert; nothing else changes with it. Its sibling player_spread_in_sd stays OFF because those modifiers are hand-set constants the fit could not measure (permutation null [0.33, 5.65]).
